description: NaCaAlOF₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.75 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and six F atoms. There is one shorter (2.65 Å) and one longer (2.66 Å) Ca-O bond length. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.47 Å. Al is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.87 Å. O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.24 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom.
